name: Anomalous Azure Portal Sign-in from External IP or Elevated Risk
description: Detects successful interactive sign-ins to the Azure Portal from external IP ranges or flagged with medium/high identity risk.
expected_signal: Targeted credential abuse or compromised user account accessing administrative cloud resources.

logic.query_template: SigninLogs | where ResultType == 0 and AppDisplayName == 'Azure Portal' and (RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ('high', 'medium') or (not(ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, '10.0.0.0/8')) and not(ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, '192.168.0.0/16'))))
